incident-bot: [ALERT] High-volume outbound log uploads detected to s3://external-logs-XXXX
carol_oncall: I'm on it. seeing spikes from the logging pipeline? can someone confirm bucket and IAM principal?

```
PUT /external-logs-XXXX/2026/03/17/part-0001
x-amz-acl: private
Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=svc-logs/...
```
alice_sre: principal: svc-logs-agent@redwood-prod
bob_security: tagging as potential data egress. @dave_infra can we block host egress to that bucket and rotate the svc-logs-agent keys asap?

```
found: 14 log files referenced by 3 distinct customer projects: cust-42, cust-88, cust-ops
timestamps: 2026-03-17T01:09:12Z -> 2026-03-17T01:16:45Z
```

```
aws s3 ls s3://external-logs-XXXX/2026/03/17/ | head -n 5
2026-03-17 01:10  2048 part-0001
```
